import Mathlib

structure WeightedGraph where
  adj : Array (Array (Nat × Int))

def WeightedGraph.size (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def WeightedGraph.has_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) : Prop :=
  u < g.size ∧
  ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w

def WeightedGraph.well_formed (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size →
    -- Bounds check
    (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
    -- Simple graph check (matches Dafny)
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

structure MSTEdge where
  u : Nat
  v : Nat
  w : Int

-- 1. Validity
def MSTEdge.is_valid (e : MSTEdge) (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.has_edge e.u e.v e.w

-- 2. Connectivity for Solution Edges (Undirected View)
-- Dafny: `edge_in_set` checks (u, v) || (v, u)
def edges_contain (edges : List MSTEdge) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ e, e ∈ edges ∧ ((e.u = u ∧ e.v = v) ∨ (e.u = v ∧ e.v = u))

def path_follows_edges (edges : List MSTEdge) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    edges_contain edges (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def is_connected_with_edges (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_edges edges p

-- 3. Spanning Tree Definition
def is_spanning_tree (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  edges.length = g.size - 1 ∧
  (∀ e, e ∈ edges → e.is_valid g) ∧
  is_connected_with_edges g edges
  -- Note: |V|-1 edges + Connected implies Acyclic (Tree)

def total_weight (edges : List MSTEdge) : Int :=
  edges.foldl (λ sum e => sum + e.w) 0

-- 4. Optimality (MST)
def is_mst (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  is_spanning_tree g edges ∧
  ∀ other, is_spanning_tree g other → total_weight edges ≤ total_weight other

-- 5. Graph Connectivity (Precondition)
-- Dafny uses directed edges for the graph path check: `graph_has_any_edge`
def path_follows_graph (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    ∃ w, g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0) w

def WeightedGraph.is_connected (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_graph g p

def WeightedGraph.weights_bounded (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.size ≤ 100000 ∧
  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w ≥ -100000 ∧ w ≤ 100000

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def kruskal_mst_precond (graph : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧
  graph.size > 0 ∧
  graph.is_connected ∧
  graph.weights_bounded
  -- !benchmark @end precond

namespace KruskalAux

/-! ## Definitional unfolding lemmas -/

lemma has_edge_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) :
    g.has_edge u v w ↔
      (u < g.size ∧ ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w) := Iff.rfl

lemma is_valid_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (e : MSTEdge) :
    e.is_valid g ↔
      (e.u < g.size ∧ ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD e.u #[] ∧ pair.1 = e.v ∧ pair.2 = e.w) := Iff.rfl

lemma pfe_unfold (L : List MSTEdge) (p : List Nat) :
    path_follows_edges L p ↔
      (p.length > 0 ∧ ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
        edges_contain L (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i+1) 0)) := Iff.rfl

lemma pfg_unfold (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) :
    path_follows_graph g p ↔
      (p.length > 0 ∧ ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
        ∃ w, g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i+1) 0) w) := Iff.rfl

lemma icwe_unfold (g : WeightedGraph) (L : List MSTEdge) :
    is_connected_with_edges g L ↔
      ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
        ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_edges L p := Iff.rfl

lemma isconn_unfold (g : WeightedGraph) :
    g.is_connected ↔
      ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
        ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_graph g p := Iff.rfl

lemma wf_unfold (g : WeightedGraph) :
    g.well_formed ↔ ∀ u, u < g.size →
      (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
      (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2) := Iff.rfl

lemma is_st_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (L : List MSTEdge) :
    is_spanning_tree g L ↔
      (L.length = g.size - 1 ∧ (∀ e, e ∈ L → e.is_valid g) ∧ is_connected_with_edges g L) :=
  Iff.rfl

lemma is_mst_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (L : List MSTEdge) :
    is_mst g L ↔
      (is_spanning_tree g L ∧
        ∀ other, is_spanning_tree g other → total_weight L ≤ total_weight other) := Iff.rfl

/-! ## Small list helpers -/

lemma gD0 (a : Nat) (l : List Nat) : (a :: l).getD 0 0 = a := by
  first | rfl | simp

lemma gDs (a : Nat) (l : List Nat) (n : Nat) : (a :: l).getD (n+1) 0 = l.getD n 0 := by
  first | rfl | simp

lemma glcc (a b : Nat) (l : List Nat) : (a :: b :: l).getLast? = (b :: l).getLast? := by
  first | rfl | simp

lemma gls (a : Nat) : ([a] : List Nat).getLast? = some a := by
  first | rfl | simp

lemma arr_mem_iff {α : Type} (a : α) (arr : Array α) : a ∈ arr ↔ a ∈ arr.toList := by
  first
    | exact Iff.rfl
    | exact Array.mem_def
    | simp

lemma getLast_getD : ∀ (p : List Nat) (b : Nat), p.getLast? = some b →
    p.getD (p.length - 1) 0 = b := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro b h; exact absurd h (by simp)
  | cons a t ih =>
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      intro b h
      rw [gls] at h
      have hab : a = b := Option.some.inj h
      have h0 : (a :: ([] : List Nat)).getD ((a :: ([] : List Nat)).length - 1) 0 = a := by
        first | rfl | simp
      exact h0.trans hab
    | cons c t' =>
      intro b h
      rw [glcc] at h
      have hrec := ih b h
      have hlen : (a :: c :: t').length - 1 = ((c :: t').length - 1) + 1 := by
        simp only [List.length_cons]; omega
      rw [hlen, gDs]
      exact hrec

/-! ## Paths as chains -/

def PFE (L : List MSTEdge) : List Nat → Prop
  | [] => False
  | [_] => True
  | a :: b :: t => edges_contain L a b ∧ PFE L (b :: t)

lemma PFE_nil (L : List MSTEdge) : PFE L [] ↔ False := Iff.rfl
lemma PFE_one (L : List MSTEdge) (a : Nat) : PFE L [a] ↔ True := Iff.rfl
lemma PFE_two (L : List MSTEdge) (a b : Nat) (t : List Nat) :
    PFE L (a :: b :: t) ↔ (edges_contain L a b ∧ PFE L (b :: t)) := Iff.rfl

lemma pfe_iff (L : List MSTEdge) (p : List Nat) :
    path_follows_edges L p ↔ PFE L p := by
  induction p with
  | nil =>
    rw [pfe_unfold, PFE_nil]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h, -⟩
      simp only [List.length_nil] at h
      omega
    · intro h; exact h.elim
  | cons a t ih =>
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      rw [pfe_unfold, PFE_one]
      constructor
      · intro _; trivial
      · intro _
        refine ⟨by simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil]; omega, ?_⟩
        intro i hi
        exfalso
        simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hi
        omega
    | cons b t' =>
      rw [pfe_unfold, PFE_two, ← ih, pfe_unfold]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨-, h⟩
        have h0 := h 0 (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega)
        rw [gD0, gDs, gD0] at h0
        refine ⟨h0, by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega, ?_⟩
        intro i hi
        have h1 := h (i+1) (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hi ⊢; omega)
        rw [gDs, gDs] at h1
        exact h1
      · rintro ⟨h1, -, h2⟩
        refine ⟨by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega, ?_⟩
        intro i hi
        cases i with
        | zero =>
          rw [gD0, gDs, gD0]
          exact h1
        | succ n =>
          rw [gDs, gDs]
          refine h2 n ?_
          simp only [List.length_cons] at hi ⊢
          omega

/-! ## Reachability -/

def RG (L : List MSTEdge) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b => edges_contain L a b) u v

lemma rg_refl (L : List MSTEdge) (u : Nat) : RG L u u := Relation.ReflTransGen.refl

lemma rg_edge {L : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat} (h : edges_contain L u v) : RG L u v :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen.single h

lemma rg_trans {L : List MSTEdge} {u v w : Nat} (h1 : RG L u v) (h2 : RG L v w) : RG L u w :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen.trans h1 h2

lemma ec_symm {L : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat} (h : edges_contain L u v) : edges_contain L v u := by
  obtain ⟨e, he, hc⟩ := h
  exact ⟨e, he, hc.symm⟩

lemma rg_symm {L : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat} (h : RG L u v) : RG L v u := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | tail hab hbc ih => exact rg_trans (rg_edge (ec_symm hbc)) ih

lemma rg_mono {L L' : List MSTEdge} (hs : ∀ e, e ∈ L → e ∈ L') {u v : Nat}
    (h : RG L u v) : RG L' u v := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | tail hab hbc ih =>
    refine rg_trans ih (rg_edge ?_)
    obtain ⟨e, he, hc⟩ := hbc
    exact ⟨e, hs e he, hc⟩

lemma path_to_RG (L : List MSTEdge) : ∀ (p : List Nat) (u v : Nat),
    p.head? = some u → p.getLast? = some v → PFE L p → RG L u v := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro u v h1 _ _; exact absurd h1 (by simp)
  | cons a t ih =>
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      intro u v h1 h2 _
      rw [gls] at h2
      have e1 : a = u := Option.some.inj h1
      have e2 : a = v := Option.some.inj h2
      subst e1; subst e2
      exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
    | cons b t' =>
      intro u v h1 h2 h3
      have e1 : a = u := Option.some.inj h1
      subst e1
      rw [glcc] at h2
      rw [PFE_two] at h3
      exact Relation.ReflTransGen.head h3.1 (ih b v rfl h2 h3.2)

lemma pfe_snoc (L : List MSTEdge) : ∀ (p : List Nat) (b c : Nat),
    p.getLast? = some b → PFE L p → edges_contain L b c →
      PFE L (p ++ [c]) ∧ (p ++ [c]).getLast? = some c ∧ (p ++ [c]).head? = p.head? := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro b c h _ _; exact absurd h (by simp)
  | cons a t ih =>
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      intro b c h _ hec
      rw [gls] at h
      have hab : a = b := Option.some.inj h
      subst hab
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show PFE L [a, c]
        exact ⟨hec, trivial⟩
      · first | rfl | simp
      · first | rfl | simp
    | cons d t' =>
      intro b c h hpfe hec
      rw [glcc] at h
      rw [PFE_two] at hpfe
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hpfe
      obtain ⟨r1, r2, r3⟩ := ih b c h h2 hec
      rw [List.cons_append] at r1 r2
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [List.cons_append, List.cons_append, PFE_two]
        exact ⟨h1, r1⟩
      · rw [List.cons_append, List.cons_append, glcc]
        exact r2
      · rw [List.cons_append]
        first | rfl | simp

lemma RG_to_path (L : List MSTEdge) {u v : Nat} (h : RG L u v) :
    ∃ p : List Nat, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ PFE L p := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact ⟨[u], rfl, rfl, trivial⟩
  | tail hab hbc ih =>
    obtain ⟨p, hp1, hp2, hp3⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨r1, r2, r3⟩ := pfe_snoc L p _ _ hp2 hp3 hbc
    exact ⟨_, by rw [r3]; exact hp1, r2, r1⟩

lemma icwe_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (L : List MSTEdge) :
    is_connected_with_edges g L ↔ ∀ u, u < g.size → ∀ v, v < g.size → RG L u v := by
  rw [icwe_unfold]
  constructor
  · intro h u hu v hv
    obtain ⟨p, h1, h2, h3⟩ := h u v hu hv
    exact path_to_RG L p u v h1 h2 ((pfe_iff L p).mp h3)
  · intro h u v hu hv
    obtain ⟨p, h1, h2, h3⟩ := RG_to_path L (h u hu v hv)
    exact ⟨p, h1, h2, (pfe_iff L p).mpr h3⟩

/-! ## Component computation (union of edges) -/

def compsF : List MSTEdge → Nat → Nat
  | [], x => x
  | e :: rest, x =>
      if compsF rest x = compsF rest e.v then compsF rest e.u else compsF rest x

lemma compsF_nil (x : Nat) : compsF [] x = x := rfl

lemma compsF_cons (e : MSTEdge) (rest : List MSTEdge) (x : Nat) :
    compsF (e :: rest) x =
      (if compsF rest x = compsF rest e.v then compsF rest e.u else compsF rest x) := rfl

lemma comps_sound : ∀ (L : List MSTEdge) (u v : Nat), compsF L u = compsF L v → RG L u v := by
  intro L
  induction L with
  | nil =>
    intro u v h
    rw [compsF_nil, compsF_nil] at h
    subst h
    exact rg_refl _ _
  | cons e rest ih =>
    intro u v h
    rw [compsF_cons, compsF_cons] at h
    have hmono : ∀ x y, RG rest x y → RG (e :: rest) x y := by
      intro x y hxy
      exact rg_mono (fun a ha => List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr ha)) hxy
    have hedge : RG (e :: rest) e.u e.v :=
      rg_edge ⟨e, List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl), Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
    by_cases h1 : compsF rest u = compsF rest e.v
    · rw [if_pos h1] at h
      by_cases h2 : compsF rest v = compsF rest e.v
      · exact hmono u v (ih u v (h1.trans h2.symm))
      · rw [if_neg h2] at h
        exact rg_trans (hmono u e.v (ih u e.v h1))
          (rg_trans (rg_symm hedge) (hmono e.u v (ih e.u v h)))
    · rw [if_neg h1] at h
      by_cases h2 : compsF rest v = compsF rest e.v
      · rw [if_pos h2] at h
        exact rg_trans (hmono u e.u (ih u e.u h))
          (rg_trans hedge (rg_symm (hmono v e.v (ih v e.v h2))))
      · rw [if_neg h2] at h
        exact hmono u v (ih u v h)

lemma comps_complete : ∀ (L : List MSTEdge), ∀ e, e ∈ L → compsF L e.u = compsF L e.v := by
  intro L
  induction L with
  | nil => intro e he; exact absurd he (by simp)
  | cons a rest ih =>
    intro e he
    rw [compsF_cons, compsF_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp he with h | h
    · subst h
      by_cases hcc : compsF rest e.u = compsF rest e.v
      · rw [if_pos hcc, if_pos (rfl : compsF rest e.v = compsF rest e.v)]
      · rw [if_neg hcc, if_pos (rfl : compsF rest e.v = compsF rest e.v)]
    · rw [ih e h]

lemma rg_comps {L : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat} (h : RG L u v) : compsF L u = compsF L v := by
  induction h with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail hab hbc ih =>
    refine ih.trans ?_
    obtain ⟨e, he, hcase⟩ := hbc
    rcases hcase with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · rw [← h1, ← h2]; exact comps_complete L e he
    · rw [← h1, ← h2]; exact (comps_complete L e he).symm

lemma rg_iff (L : List MSTEdge) (u v : Nat) : RG L u v ↔ compsF L u = compsF L v :=
  ⟨fun h => rg_comps h, fun h => comps_sound L u v h⟩

/-! ## Decision procedures -/

def validB (g : WeightedGraph) (e : MSTEdge) : Bool :=
  decide (e.u < g.size) &&
    ((g.adj.getD e.u #[]).toList.any (fun pr => decide (pr.1 = e.v) && decide (pr.2 = e.w)))

lemma validB_def (g : WeightedGraph) (e : MSTEdge) :
    validB g e = (decide (e.u < g.size) &&
      ((g.adj.getD e.u #[]).toList.any
        (fun pr => decide (pr.1 = e.v) && decide (pr.2 = e.w)))) := rfl

lemma validB_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (e : MSTEdge) : validB g e = true ↔ e.is_valid g := by
  rw [is_valid_iff, validB_def]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [Bool.and_eq_true] at h
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h
    rw [decide_eq_true_eq] at h1
    rw [List.any_eq_true] at h2
    obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hpr2⟩ := h2
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hpr2
    exact ⟨h1, pr, (arr_mem_iff pr _).mpr hpr, hpr2.1, hpr2.2⟩
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨h1, pr, hpr, hpr1, hpr2⟩ := h
    rw [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, List.any_eq_true]
    refine ⟨h1, pr, (arr_mem_iff pr _).mp hpr, ?_⟩
    show (decide (pr.1 = e.v) && decide (pr.2 = e.w)) = true
    rw [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, decide_eq_true_eq]
    exact ⟨hpr1, hpr2⟩

def connB (g : WeightedGraph) (L : List MSTEdge) : Bool :=
  (List.range g.size).all
    (fun u => (List.range g.size).all (fun v => decide (compsF L u = compsF L v)))

lemma connB_def (g : WeightedGraph) (L : List MSTEdge) :
    connB g L = (List.range g.size).all
      (fun u => (List.range g.size).all (fun v => decide (compsF L u = compsF L v))) := rfl

lemma connB_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (L : List MSTEdge) :
    connB g L = true ↔ is_connected_with_edges g L := by
  rw [connB_def, icwe_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h u hu v hv
    rw [rg_iff]
    have h1 := List.all_eq_true.mp h u (List.mem_range.mpr hu)
    have h2 := List.all_eq_true.mp h1 v (List.mem_range.mpr hv)
    exact of_decide_eq_true h2
  · intro h
    refine List.all_eq_true.mpr ?_
    intro u hu
    refine List.all_eq_true.mpr ?_
    intro v hv
    exact decide_eq_true ((rg_iff L u v).mp (h u (List.mem_range.mp hu) v (List.mem_range.mp hv)))

def isSTB (g : WeightedGraph) (L : List MSTEdge) : Bool :=
  (decide (L.length = g.size - 1) && L.all (validB g)) && connB g L

lemma isSTB_def (g : WeightedGraph) (L : List MSTEdge) :
    isSTB g L = ((decide (L.length = g.size - 1) && L.all (validB g)) && connB g L) := rfl

lemma isSTB_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (L : List MSTEdge) :
    isSTB g L = true ↔ is_spanning_tree g L := by
  rw [isSTB_def, is_st_iff, Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
    List.all_eq_true, connB_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩
    exact ⟨h1, fun e he => (validB_iff g e).mp (h2 e he), h3⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    exact ⟨⟨h1, fun e he => (validB_iff g e).mpr (h2 e he)⟩, h3⟩

/-! ## Enumeration -/

def concatMap {α β : Type} (f : α → List β) : List α → List β
  | [] => []
  | a :: t => f a ++ concatMap f t

lemma concatMap_nil {α β : Type} (f : α → List β) : concatMap f [] = [] := rfl

lemma concatMap_cons {α β : Type} (f : α → List β) (a : α) (t : List α) :
    concatMap f (a :: t) = f a ++ concatMap f t := rfl

lemma mem_concatMap {α β : Type} (f : α → List β) (b : β) :
    ∀ l : List α, b ∈ concatMap f l ↔ ∃ a, a ∈ l ∧ b ∈ f a := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    rw [concatMap_nil]
    constructor
    · intro h; exact absurd h (by simp)
    · rintro ⟨a, ha, -⟩; exact absurd ha (by simp)
  | cons a t ih =>
    rw [concatMap_cons, List.mem_append, ih]
    constructor
    · rintro (h | ⟨x, hx, hb⟩)
      · exact ⟨a, List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl), h⟩
      · exact ⟨x, List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hx), hb⟩
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, hb⟩
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with h | h
      · subst h; exact Or.inl hb
      · exact Or.inr ⟨x, h, hb⟩

def allEdges (g : WeightedGraph) : List MSTEdge :=
  concatMap (fun u => ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.map (fun pr => (⟨u, pr.1, pr.2⟩ : MSTEdge))))
    (List.range g.size)

lemma allEdges_def (g : WeightedGraph) : allEdges g =
    concatMap (fun u => ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.map (fun pr => (⟨u, pr.1, pr.2⟩ : MSTEdge))))
      (List.range g.size) := rfl

lemma valid_mem_allEdges (g : WeightedGraph) (e : MSTEdge) (h : e.is_valid g) :
    e ∈ allEdges g := by
  rw [is_valid_iff] at h
  obtain ⟨h1, pr, hpr, hpr1, hpr2⟩ := h
  rw [allEdges_def, mem_concatMap]
  refine ⟨e.u, List.mem_range.mpr h1, ?_⟩
  refine List.mem_map.mpr ⟨pr, (arr_mem_iff pr _).mp hpr, ?_⟩
  show (⟨e.u, pr.1, pr.2⟩ : MSTEdge) = e
  rw [hpr1, hpr2]

def tuples (es : List MSTEdge) : Nat → List (List MSTEdge)
  | 0 => [[]]
  | k + 1 => concatMap (fun e => (tuples es k).map (fun l => e :: l)) es

lemma tuples_zero (es : List MSTEdge) : tuples es 0 = [[]] := rfl

lemma tuples_succ (es : List MSTEdge) (k : Nat) :
    tuples es (k+1) = concatMap (fun e => (tuples es k).map (fun l => e :: l)) es := rfl

lemma mem_tuples (es : List MSTEdge) : ∀ (k : Nat) (L : List MSTEdge),
    L.length = k → (∀ e, e ∈ L → e ∈ es) → L ∈ tuples es k := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro L hL _
    cases L with
    | nil => rw [tuples_zero]; exact List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl)
    | cons a t => simp at hL
  | succ n ih =>
    intro L hL hmem
    cases L with
    | nil => simp at hL
    | cons a t =>
      have ht : t.length = n := by simp only [List.length_cons] at hL; omega
      have h1 : t ∈ tuples es n := ih t ht (fun e he => hmem e (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr he)))
      rw [tuples_succ, mem_concatMap]
      exact ⟨a, hmem a (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl)), List.mem_map.mpr ⟨t, h1, rfl⟩⟩

/-! ## Choosing a minimum -/

def bestOf : List MSTEdge → List (List MSTEdge) → List MSTEdge
  | best, [] => best
  | best, L :: rest => bestOf (if total_weight L < total_weight best then L else best) rest

lemma bestOf_nil (b : List MSTEdge) : bestOf b [] = b := rfl

lemma bestOf_cons (b L : List MSTEdge) (rest : List (List MSTEdge)) :
    bestOf b (L :: rest) = bestOf (if total_weight L < total_weight b then L else b) rest := rfl

lemma bestOf_le : ∀ (cs : List (List MSTEdge)) (b : List MSTEdge),
    total_weight (bestOf b cs) ≤ total_weight b := by
  intro cs
  induction cs with
  | nil => intro b; exact le_of_eq (congrArg total_weight (bestOf_nil b))
  | cons L rest ih =>
    intro b
    rw [bestOf_cons]
    refine le_trans (ih _) ?_
    split
    · rename_i hc
      exact le_of_lt hc
    · exact le_refl _

lemma bestOf_mem : ∀ (cs : List (List MSTEdge)) (b : List MSTEdge),
    bestOf b cs = b ∨ bestOf b cs ∈ cs := by
  intro cs
  induction cs with
  | nil => intro b; exact Or.inl (bestOf_nil b)
  | cons L rest ih =>
    intro b
    rw [bestOf_cons]
    rcases ih (if total_weight L < total_weight b then L else b) with h | h
    · rw [h]
      split
      · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl))
      · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr h))

lemma bestOf_min : ∀ (cs : List (List MSTEdge)) (b : List MSTEdge) (M : List MSTEdge),
    M ∈ cs → total_weight (bestOf b cs) ≤ total_weight M := by
  intro cs
  induction cs with
  | nil => intro b M hM; exact absurd hM (by simp)
  | cons L rest ih =>
    intro b M hM
    rw [bestOf_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hM with h | h
    · subst h
      refine le_trans (bestOf_le rest _) ?_
      split
      · exact le_refl _
      · rename_i hc
        first
          | exact le_of_not_gt hc
          | exact not_lt.mp hc
          | omega
    · exact ih _ M h

def pickBest : List (List MSTEdge) → List MSTEdge
  | [] => []
  | L :: rest => bestOf L rest

lemma pickBest_mem (c : List MSTEdge) (cs : List (List MSTEdge)) :
    pickBest (c :: cs) ∈ c :: cs := by
  show bestOf c cs ∈ c :: cs
  rcases bestOf_mem cs c with h | h
  · rw [h]; exact List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl)
  · exact List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr h)

lemma pickBest_min (c : List MSTEdge) (cs : List (List MSTEdge)) :
    ∀ M, M ∈ c :: cs → total_weight (pickBest (c :: cs)) ≤ total_weight M := by
  intro M hM
  show total_weight (bestOf c cs) ≤ total_weight M
  rcases List.mem_cons.mp hM with h | h
  · subst h; exact bestOf_le _ _
  · exact bestOf_min cs c M h

/-! ## Existence of a spanning tree -/

lemma spanning_exists (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) (hconn : g.is_connected)
    (hpos : 0 < g.size) :
    ∀ k : Nat, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ g.size →
      ∃ (S : Finset Nat) (L : List MSTEdge),
        (∀ x, x ∈ S → x < g.size) ∧ S.card = k ∧ L.length = k - 1 ∧
        (∀ e, e ∈ L → e.is_valid g) ∧ (∀ u, u ∈ S → ∀ v, v ∈ S → RG L u v) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro h; exact absurd h (by omega)
  | succ n ih =>
    intro _ hle
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with hn0 | hn
    · subst hn0
      refine ⟨{0}, [], ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro x hx
        rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
        subst hx; exact hpos
      · simp
      · simp
      · intro e he; exact absurd he (by simp)
      · intro u hu v hv
        rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hu hv
        subst hu; subst hv
        exact rg_refl _ _
    · obtain ⟨S, L, hS, hScard, hLlen, hLval, hRG⟩ := ih hn (by omega)
      have hbex : ∃ b, b < g.size ∧ b ∉ S := by
        by_contra hcon
        push_neg at hcon
        have hsub : Finset.range g.size ⊆ S := by
          intro x hx
          exact hcon x (Finset.mem_range.mp hx)
        have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsub
        rw [Finset.card_range, hScard] at hcard
        omega
      obtain ⟨b, hblt, hbnot⟩ := hbex
      have hSne : S.Nonempty := by
        rw [← Finset.card_pos, hScard]; omega
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hSne
      have halt : a < g.size := hS a ha
      obtain ⟨p, hp1, hp2, hp3⟩ := (isconn_unfold g).mp hconn a b halt hblt
      rw [pfg_unfold] at hp3
      obtain ⟨hplen, hstep⟩ := hp3
      have hstart : p.getD 0 0 = a := by
        cases p with
        | nil => exact absurd hp1 (by simp)
        | cons x t =>
          have hx : x = a := Option.some.inj hp1
          rw [gD0]; exact hx
      have hend : p.getD (p.length - 1) 0 = b := getLast_getD p b hp2
      classical
      have hexi : ∃ i, i < p.length ∧ p.getD i 0 ∉ S :=
        ⟨p.length - 1, by omega, by rw [hend]; exact hbnot⟩
      have hspec := Nat.find_spec hexi
      have hne0 : Nat.find hexi ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        have h2 := hspec.2
        rw [h0, hstart] at h2
        exact h2 ha
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, Nat.find hexi = j + 1 := ⟨Nat.find hexi - 1, by omega⟩
      have hjlen : j + 1 < p.length := by rw [← hj]; exact hspec.1
      have hjnot := Nat.find_min hexi (show j < Nat.find hexi by omega)
      have hjS : p.getD j 0 ∈ S := by
        by_contra hc
        exact hjnot ⟨by omega, hc⟩
      have hynot : p.getD (j+1) 0 ∉ S := by rw [← hj]; exact hspec.2
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hstep j hjlen
      set x := p.getD j 0 with hxdef
      set y := p.getD (j+1) 0 with hydef
      have hxlt : x < g.size := ((has_edge_iff g x y w).mp hw).1
      have hylt : y < g.size := by
        obtain ⟨-, pr, hpr, hpr1, -⟩ := (has_edge_iff g x y w).mp hw
        have hb2 := ((wf_unfold g).mp hwf x hxlt).1 pr hpr
        rw [← hpr1]; exact hb2
      refine ⟨insert y S, ⟨x, y, w⟩ :: L, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro z hz
        rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hz with h | h
        · subst h; exact hylt
        · exact hS z h
      · first
          | rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hynot, hScard]
          | rw [Finset.card_insert_of_not_mem hynot, hScard]
          | simp [hynot, hScard]
      · simp only [List.length_cons, hLlen]
        omega
      · intro e he
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp he with h | h
        · subst h; exact hw
        · exact hLval e h
      · have hmono : ∀ u v, RG L u v → RG (⟨x, y, w⟩ :: L) u v := by
          intro u v huv
          exact rg_mono (fun a2 ha2 => List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr ha2)) huv
        have hedge : RG (⟨x, y, w⟩ :: L) x y :=
          rg_edge ⟨⟨x, y, w⟩, List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl), Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
        have hall : ∀ u, u ∈ insert y S → RG (⟨x, y, w⟩ :: L) u x := by
          intro u hu
          rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hu with h | h
          · subst h; exact rg_symm hedge
          · exact hmono u x (hRG u h x hjS)
        intro u hu v hv
        exact rg_trans (hall u hu) (rg_symm (hall v hv))

lemma exists_st (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) (hconn : g.is_connected)
    (hpos : 0 < g.size) : ∃ L : List MSTEdge, is_spanning_tree g L := by
  obtain ⟨S, L, hS, hScard, hLlen, hLval, hRG⟩ :=
    spanning_exists g hwf hconn hpos g.size (by omega) (le_refl _)
  have hsub : S ⊆ Finset.range g.size := by
    intro x hx; exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (hS x hx)
  have hSeq : S = Finset.range g.size := by
    apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub
    have h1 : (Finset.range g.size).card = g.size := Finset.card_range _
    omega
  have hmem : ∀ u, u < g.size → u ∈ S := by
    intro u hu; rw [hSeq]; exact Finset.mem_range.mpr hu
  refine ⟨L, (is_st_iff g L).mpr ⟨hLlen, hLval, ?_⟩⟩
  exact (icwe_iff g L).mpr (fun u hu v hv => hRG u (hmem u hu) v (hmem v hv))

/-! ## The algorithm -/

def candidates (g : WeightedGraph) : List (List MSTEdge) :=
  List.filter (isSTB g) (tuples (allEdges g) (g.size - 1))

lemma candidates_def (g : WeightedGraph) :
    candidates g = List.filter (isSTB g) (tuples (allEdges g) (g.size - 1)) := rfl

lemma mem_candidates (g : WeightedGraph) (M : List MSTEdge) :
    M ∈ candidates g ↔ is_spanning_tree g M := by
  rw [candidates_def, List.mem_filter]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, h⟩
    exact (isSTB_iff g M).mp h
  · intro h
    refine ⟨mem_tuples _ _ M ((is_st_iff g M).mp h).1 ?_, (isSTB_iff g M).mpr h⟩
    intro e he
    exact valid_mem_allEdges g e (((is_st_iff g M).mp h).2.1 e he)

def kruskal_impl (g : WeightedGraph) : List MSTEdge := pickBest (candidates g)

lemma kruskal_impl_def (g : WeightedGraph) : kruskal_impl g = pickBest (candidates g) := rfl

end KruskalAux
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def kruskal_mst (graph : WeightedGraph)
    (h_precond : kruskal_mst_precond graph) : List MSTEdge :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  KruskalAux.kruskal_impl graph
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def kruskal_mst_postcond (graph : WeightedGraph) (result : List MSTEdge)
    (_ : kruskal_mst_precond graph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_mst graph result
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
open KruskalAux
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem kruskal_mst_postcond_satisfied (graph : WeightedGraph)
    (h_precond : kruskal_mst_precond graph) :
    kruskal_mst_postcond graph (kruskal_mst graph h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  show is_mst graph (KruskalAux.kruskal_impl graph)
  obtain ⟨hwf, hpos, hconn, hbdd⟩ := h_precond
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := KruskalAux.exists_st graph hwf hconn hpos
  have hTmem : T ∈ KruskalAux.candidates graph :=
    (KruskalAux.mem_candidates graph T).mpr hT
  rw [KruskalAux.kruskal_impl_def]
  cases hc : KruskalAux.candidates graph with
  | nil =>
    rw [hc] at hTmem
    exact absurd hTmem (by simp)
  | cons c cs =>
    refine (KruskalAux.is_mst_iff graph _).mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have h1 : KruskalAux.pickBest (c :: cs) ∈ KruskalAux.candidates graph := by
        rw [hc]; exact KruskalAux.pickBest_mem c cs
      exact (KruskalAux.mem_candidates graph _).mp h1
    · intro other hother
      have h2 : other ∈ c :: cs := by
        rw [← hc]; exact (KruskalAux.mem_candidates graph other).mpr hother
      exact KruskalAux.pickBest_min c cs other h2
  -- !benchmark @end proof

structure MSTEdge where
  u : Nat
  v : Nat
  w : Int

-- 1. Validity
def MSTEdge.is_valid (e : MSTEdge) (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.has_edge e.u e.v e.w

-- 2. Connectivity for Solution Edges (Undirected View)
-- Dafny: `edge_in_set` checks (u, v) || (v, u)
def edges_contain (edges : List MSTEdge) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ e, e ∈ edges ∧ ((e.u = u ∧ e.v = v) ∨ (e.u = v ∧ e.v = u))

def path_follows_edges (edges : List MSTEdge) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    edges_contain edges (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def is_connected_with_edges (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_edges edges p

-- 3. Spanning Tree Definition
def is_spanning_tree (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  edges.length = g.size - 1 ∧
  (∀ e, e ∈ edges → e.is_valid g) ∧
  is_connected_with_edges g edges
  -- Note: |V|-1 edges + Connected implies Acyclic (Tree)

def total_weight (edges : List MSTEdge) : Int :=
  edges.foldl (λ sum e => sum + e.w) 0

-- 4. Optimality (MST)
def is_mst (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  is_spanning_tree g edges ∧
  ∀ other, is_spanning_tree g other → total_weight edges ≤ total_weight other

def RG (L : List MSTEdge) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b => edges_contain L a b) u v

lemma rg_refl (L : List MSTEdge) (u : Nat) : RG L u u := Relation.ReflTransGen.refl

lemma rg_edge {L : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat} (h : edges_contain L u v) : RG L u v :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen.single h

lemma rg_trans {L : List MSTEdge} {u v w : Nat} (h1 : RG L u v) (h2 : RG L v w) : RG L u w :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen.trans h1 h2

lemma ec_symm {L : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat} (h : edges_contain L u v) : edges_contain L v u := by
  obtain ⟨e, he, hc⟩ := h
  exact ⟨e, he, hc.symm⟩

lemma rg_symm {L : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat} (h : RG L u v) : RG L v u := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact rg_refl L u
  | tail hab hbc ih => exact rg_trans (rg_edge (ec_symm hbc)) ih

lemma rg_mono {L L' : List MSTEdge} (hs : ∀ e, e ∈ L → e ∈ L') {u v : Nat}
    (h : RG L u v) : RG L' u v := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact rg_refl L' u
  | tail hab hbc ih =>
    refine rg_trans ih (rg_edge ?_)
    obtain ⟨e, he, hc⟩ := hbc
    exact ⟨e, hs e he, hc⟩

lemma spanning_exists (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) (hconn : g.is_connected)
    (hpos : 0 < g.size) :
    ∀ k : Nat, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ g.size →
      ∃ (S : Finset Nat) (L : List MSTEdge),
        (∀ x ∈ S, x < g.size) ∧ S.card = k ∧ L.length = k - 1 ∧
        (∀ e ∈ L, e.is_valid g) ∧ (∀ u ∈ S, ∀ v ∈ S, RG L u v) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro h; exact absurd h (by omega)
  | succ n ih =>
    intro _ hle
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with hn0 | hn
    · subst hn0
      refine ⟨{0}, [], ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro x hx
        rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
        subst hx; exact hpos
      · simp
      · simp
      · intro e he; simp at he
      · intro u hu v hv
        rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hu hv
        subst hu; subst hv
        exact rg_refl _ _
    · obtain ⟨S, L, hS, hScard, hLlen, hLval, hRG⟩ := ih hn (by omega)
      have hnlt : n < g.size := by omega
      have hbex : ∃ b, b < g.size ∧ b ∉ S := by
        by_contra hcon
        push_neg at hcon
        have hsub : Finset.range g.size ⊆ S := by
          intro x hx
          exact hcon x (Finset.mem_range.mp hx)
        have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsub
        rw [Finset.card_range, hScard] at hcard
        omega
      obtain ⟨b, hblt, hbnot⟩ := hbex
      have hSne : S.Nonempty := by
        rw [← Finset.card_pos, hScard]; omega
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hSne
      have halt : a < g.size := hS a ha
      obtain ⟨p, hp1, hp2, hp3⟩ := (isconn_unfold g).mp hconn a b halt hblt
      rw [pfg_unfold] at hp3
      obtain ⟨hplen, hstep⟩ := hp3
      have hstart : p.getD 0 0 = a := by
        cases p with
        | nil => exact absurd hp1 (by simp)
        | cons x t =>
          have : x = a := Option.some.inj hp1
          rw [gD0]; exact this
      have hend : p.getD (p.length - 1) 0 = b := getLast_getD p b hp2
      classical
      have hexi : ∃ i, i < p.length ∧ p.getD i 0 ∉ S :=
        ⟨p.length - 1, by omega, by rw [hend]; exact hbnot⟩
      have hspec := Nat.find_spec hexi
      have hne0 : Nat.find hexi ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        have h2 := hspec.2
        rw [h0, hstart] at h2
        exact h2 ha
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, Nat.find hexi = j + 1 := ⟨Nat.find hexi - 1, by omega⟩
      have hjlen : j + 1 < p.length := by rw [← hj]; exact hspec.1
      have hjnot := Nat.find_min hexi (show j < Nat.find hexi by omega)
      have hjS : p.getD j 0 ∈ S := by
        by_contra hc
        exact hjnot ⟨by omega, hc⟩
      have hynot : p.getD (j+1) 0 ∉ S := by rw [← hj]; exact hspec.2
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hstep j hjlen
      set x := p.getD j 0
      set y := p.getD (j+1) 0
      have hxlt : x < g.size := ((has_edge_iff g x y w).mp hw).1
      have hylt : y < g.size := by
        obtain ⟨-, pr, hpr, hpr1, -⟩ := (has_edge_iff g x y w).mp hw
        have := ((wf_unfold g).mp hwf x hxlt).1 pr hpr
        rw [← hpr1]; exact this
      refine ⟨insert y S, ⟨x, y, w⟩ :: L, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro z hz
        rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hz with h | h
        · subst h; exact hylt
        · exact hS z h
      · rw [Finset.card_insert_of_not_mem hynot, hScard]
      · simp only [List.length_cons, hLlen]
        omega
      · intro e he
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp he with h | h
        · subst h; exact hw
        · exact hLval e h
      · have hmono : ∀ u v, RG L u v → RG (⟨x, y, w⟩ :: L) u v := by
          intro u v h
          exact rg_mono (fun e he => List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr he)) h
        have hedge : RG (⟨x, y, w⟩ :: L) x y :=
          rg_edge ⟨⟨x, y, w⟩, List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl), Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
        have hall : ∀ u ∈ insert y S, RG (⟨x, y, w⟩ :: L) u x := by
          intro u hu
          rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hu with h | h
          · subst h; exact rg_symm hedge
          · exact hmono u x (hRG u h x hjS)
        intro u hu v hv
        exact rg_trans (hall u hu) (rg_symm (hall v hv))

def concatMap {α β : Type} (f : α → List β) : List α → List β
  | [] => []
  | a :: t => f a ++ concatMap f t

lemma concatMap_nil {α β : Type} (f : α → List β) : concatMap f [] = [] := rfl
lemma concatMap_cons {α β : Type} (f : α → List β) (a : α) (t : List α) :
    concatMap f (a :: t) = f a ++ concatMap f t := rfl

lemma mem_concatMap {α β : Type} (f : α → List β) (b : β) :
    ∀ l : List α, b ∈ concatMap f l ↔ ∃ a, a ∈ l ∧ b ∈ f a := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    rw [concatMap_nil]
    constructor
    · intro h; exact absurd h (by simp)
    · rintro ⟨a, ha, -⟩; exact absurd ha (by simp)
  | cons a t ih =>
    rw [concatMap_cons, List.mem_append, ih]
    constructor
    · rintro (h | ⟨x, hx, hb⟩)
      · exact ⟨a, List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl), h⟩
      · exact ⟨x, List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hx), hb⟩
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, hb⟩
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with h | h
      · subst h; exact Or.inl hb
      · exact Or.inr ⟨x, h, hb⟩

```lean4
import Mathlib

structure WeightedGraph where
  adj : Array (Array (Nat × Int))

def WeightedGraph.size (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def WeightedGraph.has_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) : Prop :=
  u < g.size ∧
  ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w

def WeightedGraph.well_formed (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size →
    -- Bounds check
    (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
    -- Simple graph check (matches Dafny)
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

structure MSTEdge where
  u : Nat
  v : Nat
  w : Int

-- 1. Validity
def MSTEdge.is_valid (e : MSTEdge) (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.has_edge e.u e.v e.w

-- 2. Connectivity for Solution Edges (Undirected View)
-- Dafny: `edge_in_set` checks (u, v) || (v, u)
def edges_contain (edges : List MSTEdge) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ e, e ∈ edges ∧ ((e.u = u ∧ e.v = v) ∨ (e.u = v ∧ e.v = u))

def path_follows_edges (edges : List MSTEdge) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    edges_contain edges (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def is_connected_with_edges (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_edges edges p

-- 3. Spanning Tree Definition
def is_spanning_tree (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  edges.length = g.size - 1 ∧
  (∀ e, e ∈ edges → e.is_valid g) ∧
  is_connected_with_edges g edges
  -- Note: |V|-1 edges + Connected implies Acyclic (Tree)

def total_weight (edges : List MSTEdge) : Int :=
  edges.foldl (λ sum e => sum + e.w) 0

-- 4. Optimality (MST)
def is_mst (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  is_spanning_tree g edges ∧
  ∀ other, is_spanning_tree g other → total_weight edges ≤ total_weight other

-- 5. Graph Connectivity (Precondition)
-- Dafny uses directed edges for the graph path check: `graph_has_any_edge`
def path_follows_graph (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    ∃ w, g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0) w

def WeightedGraph.is_connected (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_graph g p

def WeightedGraph.weights_bounded (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.size ≤ 100000 ∧
  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w ≥ -100000 ∧ w ≤ 100000

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def kruskal_mst_precond (graph : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧
  graph.size > 0 ∧
  graph.is_connected ∧
  graph.weights_bounded
  -- !benchmark @end precond

/-! ## Unfolding lemmas (definitional) -/

lemma has_edge_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) :
    g.has_edge u v w ↔
      (u < g.size ∧ ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w) := Iff.rfl

lemma is_valid_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (e : MSTEdge) :
    e.is_valid g ↔
      (e.u < g.size ∧ ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD e.u #[] ∧ pair.1 = e.v ∧ pair.2 = e.w) := Iff.rfl

lemma pfe_unfold (L : List MSTEdge) (p : List Nat) :
    path_follows_edges L p ↔
      (p.length > 0 ∧ ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
        edges_contain L (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i+1) 0)) := Iff.rfl

lemma pfg_unfold (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) :
    path_follows_graph g p ↔
      (p.length > 0 ∧ ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
        ∃ w, g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i+1) 0) w) := Iff.rfl

lemma icwe_unfold (g : WeightedGraph) (L : List MSTEdge) :
    is_connected_with_edges g L ↔
      ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
        ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_edges L p := Iff.rfl

lemma isconn_unfold (g : WeightedGraph) :
    g.is_connected ↔
      ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
        ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_graph g p := Iff.rfl

lemma wf_unfold (g : WeightedGraph) :
    g.well_formed ↔ ∀ u, u < g.size →
      (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
      (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2) := Iff.rfl

lemma is_st_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (L : List MSTEdge) :
    is_spanning_tree g L ↔
      (L.length = g.size - 1 ∧ (∀ e, e ∈ L → e.is_valid g) ∧ is_connected_with_edges g L) :=
  Iff.rfl

lemma is_mst_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (L : List MSTEdge) :
    is_mst g L ↔
      (is_spanning_tree g L ∧
        ∀ other, is_spanning_tree g other → total_weight L ≤ total_weight other) := Iff.rfl

/-! ## Small list helpers -/

lemma gD0 (a : Nat) (l : List Nat) : (a :: l).getD 0 0 = a := by
  first | rfl | simp

lemma gDs (a : Nat) (l : List Nat) (n : Nat) : (a :: l).getD (n+1) 0 = l.getD n 0 := by
  first | rfl | simp

lemma glcc (a b : Nat) (l : List Nat) : (a :: b :: l).getLast? = (b :: l).getLast? := by
  first | rfl | simp

lemma gls (a : Nat) : ([a] : List Nat).getLast? = some a := by
  first | rfl | simp

lemma arr_mem_iff {α : Type} (a : α) (arr : Array α) : a ∈ arr ↔ a ∈ arr.toList := by
  first
    | exact Iff.rfl
    | exact Array.mem_def
    | simp

lemma getLast_getD : ∀ (p : List Nat) (b : Nat), p.getLast? = some b →
    p.getD (p.length - 1) 0 = b := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro b h; exact absurd h (by simp)
  | cons a t ih =>
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      intro b h
      rw [gls] at h
      have hab : a = b := Option.some.inj h
      have h0 : (a :: ([] : List Nat)).getD ((a :: ([] : List Nat)).length - 1) 0 = a := by
        first | rfl | simp
      exact h0.trans hab
    | cons c t' =>
      intro b h
      rw [glcc] at h
      have hrec := ih b h
      have hlen : (a :: c :: t').length - 1 = ((c :: t').length - 1) + 1 := by
        simp only [List.length_cons]; omega
      rw [hlen, gDs]
      exact hrec

def PFE (L : List MSTEdge) : List Nat → Prop

lemma PFE_two (L : List MSTEdge) (a b : Nat) (t : List Nat) :

structure WeightedGraph where
  adj : Array (Array (Nat × Int))

def WeightedGraph.size (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def WeightedGraph.has_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) : Prop :=
  u < g.size ∧

def WeightedGraph.well_formed (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size →
    -- Bounds check
    (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
    -- Simple graph check (matches Dafny)
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

structure MSTEdge where
  u : Nat
  v : Nat
  w : Int

-- 1. Validity
def MSTEdge.is_valid (e : MSTEdge) (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.has_edge e.u e.v e.w

-- 2. Connectivity for Solution Edges (Undirected View)
-- Dafny: `edge_in_set` checks (u, v) || (v, u)
def edges_contain (edges : List MSTEdge) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ e, e ∈ edges ∧ ((e.u = u ∧ e.v = v) ∨ (e.u = v ∧ e.v = u))

def path_follows_edges (edges : List MSTEdge) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    edges_contain edges (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def is_connected_with_edges (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_edges edges p

-- 3. Spanning Tree Definition
def is_spanning_tree (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  edges.length = g.size - 1 ∧
  (∀ e, e ∈ edges → e.is_valid g) ∧
  is_connected_with_edges g edges
  -- Note: |V|-1 edges + Connected implies Acyclic (Tree)

def total_weight (edges : List MSTEdge) : Int :=
  edges.foldl (λ sum e => sum + e.w) 0

-- 4. Optimality (MST)
def is_mst (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  is_spanning_tree g edges ∧
  ∀ other, is_spanning_tree g other → total_weight edges ≤ total_weight other

-- Dafny uses directed edges for the graph path check: `graph_has_any_edge`

  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    ∃ w, g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0) w

  ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_graph g p

      rw [glcc] at h2
      rw [PFE_two] at h3

def compsF : List MSTEdge → Nat → Nat
  | [], x => x
  | e :: rest, x =>
      if compsF rest x = compsF rest e.v then compsF rest e.u else compsF rest x

lemma compsF_nil (x : Nat) : compsF [] x = x := rfl

    compsF (e :: rest) x =

    · rintro ⟨a, ha, -⟩; exact absurd ha (by simp)
  | cons a t ih =>
    rw [concatMap_cons, List.mem_append, ih]

    · rintro (h | ⟨x, hx, hb⟩)
      · exact ⟨a, List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl), h⟩
      · exact ⟨x, List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hx), hb⟩
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, hb⟩
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with h | h
      · subst h; exact Or.inl hb
      · exact Or.inr ⟨x, h, hb⟩

def allEdges (g : WeightedGraph) : List MSTEdge :=
  concatMap (fun u => ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.map (fun pr => (⟨u, pr.1, pr.2⟩ : MSTEdge))))
    (List.range g.size)

lemma allEdges_def (g : WeightedGraph) : allEdges g =
    concatMap (fun u => ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.map (fun pr => (⟨u, pr.1, pr.2⟩ : MSTEdge))))

lemma tuples_zero (es : List MSTEdge) : tuples es 0 = [[]] := rfl

lemma tuples_succ (es : List MSTEdge) (k : Nat) :

/-! ## Choosing a minimum -/

def bestOf : List MSTEdge → List (List MSTEdge) → List MSTEdge
  | best, [] => best
  | best, L :: rest => bestOf (if total_weight L < total_weight best then L else best) rest

lemma bestOf_nil (b : List MSTEdge) : bestOf b [] = b := rfl

lemma bestOf_cons (b L : List MSTEdge) (rest : List (List MSTEdge)) :
    bestOf b (L :: rest) = bestOf (if total_weight L < total_weight b then L else b) rest := rfl

lemma bestOf_le : ∀ (cs : List (List MSTEdge)) (b : List MSTEdge),
    total_weight (bestOf b cs) ≤ total_weight b := by
  intro cs
  induction cs with
  | nil => intro b; exact le_of_eq (congrArg total_weight (bestOf_nil b))
  | cons L rest ih =>
    intro b
    rw [bestOf_cons]
    refine le_trans (ih _) ?_
    split
    · rename_i hc
      exact le_of_lt hc
    · exact le_refl _

lemma bestOf_mem : ∀ (cs : List (List MSTEdge)) (b : List MSTEdge),
    bestOf b cs = b ∨ bestOf b cs ∈ cs := by
  intro cs
  induction cs with
  | nil => intro b; exact Or.inl (bestOf_nil b)
  | cons L rest ih =>
    intro b
    rw [bestOf_cons]
    rcases ih (if total_weight L < total_weight b then L else b) with h | h
    · rw [h]
      split
      · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl))
      · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr h))

lemma bestOf_min : ∀ (cs : List (List MSTEdge)) (b : List MSTEdge) (M : List MSTEdge),
    M ∈ cs → total_weight (bestOf b cs) ≤ total_weight M := by
  intro cs
  induction cs with
  | nil => intro b M hM; exact absurd hM (by simp)
  | cons L rest ih =>
    intro b M hM
    rw [bestOf_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hM with h | h
    · subst h
      refine le_trans (bestOf_le rest _) ?_
      split
      · exact le_refl _
      · rename_i hc
        first
          | exact le_of_not_lt hc
          | exact not_lt.mp hc
          | omega
    · exact ih _ M h

def pickBest : List (List MSTEdge) → List MSTEdge
  | [] => []
  | L :: rest => bestOf L rest

lemma pickBest_mem (c : List MSTEdge) (cs : List (List MSTEdge)) :
    pickBest (c :: cs) ∈ c :: cs := by
  show bestOf c cs ∈ c :: cs
  rcases bestOf_mem cs c with h | h
  · rw [h]; exact List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl)
  · exact List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr h)

lemma pickBest_min (c : List MSTEdge) (cs : List (List MSTEdge)) :
    ∀ M, M ∈ c :: cs → total_weight (pickBest (c :: cs)) ≤ total_weight M := by
  intro M hM
  show total_weight (bestOf c cs) ≤ total_weight M
  rcases List.mem_cons.mp hM with h | h
  · subst h; exact bestOf_le _ _
  · exact bestOf_min cs c M h

    (hpos : 0 < g.size) : ∃ L : List MSTEdge, is_spanning_tree g L := by
  obtain ⟨S, L, hS, hScard, hLlen, hLval, hRG⟩ :=
    spanning_exists g hwf hconn hpos g.size (by omega) (le_refl _)
  have hsub : S ⊆ Finset.range g.size := by
    intro x hx; exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (hS x hx)
  have hSeq : S = Finset.range g.size := by
    apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub
    have h1 : (Finset.range g.size).card = g.size := Finset.card_range _
    omega
  have hmem : ∀ u, u < g.size → u ∈ S := by
    intro u hu; rw [hSeq]; exact Finset.mem_range.mpr hu
  refine ⟨L, (is_st_iff g L).mpr ⟨hLlen, hLval, ?_⟩⟩
  exact (icwe_iff g L).mpr (fun u hu v hv => hRG u (hmem u hu) v (hmem v hv))

/-! ## The algorithm -/

def candidates (g : WeightedGraph) : List (List MSTEdge) :=
  List.filter (isSTB g) (tuples (allEdges g) (g.size - 1))

lemma candidates_def (g : WeightedGraph) :
    candidates g = List.filter (isSTB g) (tuples (allEdges g) (g.size - 1)) := rfl

lemma mem_candidates (g : WeightedGraph) (M : List MSTEdge) :
    M ∈ candidates g ↔ is_spanning_tree g M := by
  rw [candidates_def, List.mem_filter]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, h⟩
    exact (isSTB_iff g M).mp h
  · intro h
    refine ⟨mem_tuples _ _ M ((is_st_iff g M).mp h).1 ?_, (isSTB_iff g M).mpr h⟩
    intro e he
    exact valid_mem_allEdges g e (((is_st_iff g M).mp h).2.1 e he)

def kruskal_impl (g : WeightedGraph) : List MSTEdge := pickBest (candidates g)

lemma kruskal_impl_def (g : WeightedGraph) : kruskal_impl g = pickBest (candidates g) := rfl

import Mathlib

structure WeightedGraph where
  adj : Array (Array (Nat × Int))

def WeightedGraph.size (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def WeightedGraph.has_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) : Prop :=
  u < g.size ∧
  ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w

def WeightedGraph.well_formed (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size →
    -- Bounds check
    (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
    -- Simple graph check (matches Dafny)
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

structure MSTEdge where
  u : Nat
  v : Nat
  w : Int

-- 1. Validity
def MSTEdge.is_valid (e : MSTEdge) (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.has_edge e.u e.v e.w

-- 2. Connectivity for Solution Edges (Undirected View)
-- Dafny: `edge_in_set` checks (u, v) || (v, u)
def edges_contain (edges : List MSTEdge) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ e, e ∈ edges ∧ ((e.u = u ∧ e.v = v) ∨ (e.u = v ∧ e.v = u))

def path_follows_edges (edges : List MSTEdge) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    edges_contain edges (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def is_connected_with_edges (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_edges edges p

-- 3. Spanning Tree Definition
def is_spanning_tree (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  edges.length = g.size - 1 ∧
  (∀ e, e ∈ edges → e.is_valid g) ∧
  is_connected_with_edges g edges
  -- Note: |V|-1 edges + Connected implies Acyclic (Tree)

def total_weight (edges : List MSTEdge) : Int :=
  edges.foldl (λ sum e => sum + e.w) 0

-- 4. Optimality (MST)
def is_mst (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  is_spanning_tree g edges ∧
  ∀ other, is_spanning_tree g other → total_weight edges ≤ total_weight other

-- 5. Graph Connectivity (Precondition)
-- Dafny uses directed edges for the graph path check: `graph_has_any_edge`
def path_follows_graph (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    ∃ w, g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0) w

def WeightedGraph.is_connected (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_graph g p

def WeightedGraph.weights_bounded (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.size ≤ 100000 ∧
  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w ≥ -100000 ∧ w ≤ 100000

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def kruskal_mst_precond (graph : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧
  graph.size > 0 ∧
  graph.is_connected ∧
  graph.weights_bounded
  -- !benchmark @end precond

namespace KruskalAux

/-! ## Definitional unfolding lemmas -/

lemma has_edge_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) :
    g.has_edge u v w ↔
      (u < g.size ∧ ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w) := Iff.rfl

lemma is_valid_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (e : MSTEdge) :
    e.is_valid g ↔
      (e.u < g.size ∧ ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD e.u #[] ∧ pair.1 = e.v ∧ pair.2 = e.w) := Iff.rfl

lemma pfe_unfold (L : List MSTEdge) (p : List Nat) :
    path_follows_edges L p ↔
      (p.length > 0 ∧ ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
        edges_contain L (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i+1) 0)) := Iff.rfl

lemma pfg_unfold (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) :
    path_follows_graph g p ↔
      (p.length > 0 ∧ ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
        ∃ w, g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i+1) 0) w) := Iff.rfl

lemma icwe_unfold (g : WeightedGraph) (L : List MSTEdge) :
    is_connected_with_edges g L ↔
      ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
        ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_edges L p := Iff.rfl

lemma isconn_unfold (g : WeightedGraph) :
    g.is_connected ↔
      ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
        ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_graph g p := Iff.rfl

lemma wf_unfold (g : WeightedGraph) :
    g.well_formed ↔ ∀ u, u < g.size →
      (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
      (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2) := Iff.rfl

lemma is_st_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (L : List MSTEdge) :
    is_spanning_tree g L ↔
      (L.length = g.size - 1 ∧ (∀ e, e ∈ L → e.is_valid g) ∧ is_connected_with_edges g L) :=
  Iff.rfl

lemma is_mst_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (L : List MSTEdge) :
    is_mst g L ↔
      (is_spanning_tree g L ∧
        ∀ other, is_spanning_tree g other → total_weight L ≤ total_weight other) := Iff.rfl

/-! ## Small list helpers -/

lemma gD0 (a : Nat) (l : List Nat) : (a :: l).getD 0 0 = a := by
  first | rfl | simp

lemma gDs (a : Nat) (l : List Nat) (n : Nat) : (a :: l).getD (n+1) 0 = l.getD n 0 := by
  first | rfl | simp

lemma glcc (a b : Nat) (l : List Nat) : (a :: b :: l).getLast? = (b :: l).getLast? := by
  first | rfl | simp

lemma gls (a : Nat) : ([a] : List Nat).getLast? = some a := by
  first | rfl | simp

lemma arr_mem_iff {α : Type} (a : α) (arr : Array α) : a ∈ arr ↔ a ∈ arr.toList := by
  first
    | exact Iff.rfl
    | exact Array.mem_def
    | simp

lemma getLast_getD : ∀ (p : List Nat) (b : Nat), p.getLast? = some b →
    p.getD (p.length - 1) 0 = b := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro b h; exact absurd h (by simp)
  | cons a t ih =>
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      intro b h
      rw [gls] at h
      have hab : a = b := Option.some.inj h
      have h0 : (a :: ([] : List Nat)).getD ((a :: ([] : List Nat)).length - 1) 0 = a := by
        first | rfl | simp
      exact h0.trans hab
    | cons c t' =>
      intro b h
      rw [glcc] at h
      have hrec := ih b h
      have hlen : (a :: c :: t').length - 1 = ((c :: t').length - 1) + 1 := by
        simp only [List.length_cons]; omega
      rw [hlen, gDs]
      exact hrec

/-! ## Paths as chains -/

def PFE (L : List MSTEdge) : List Nat → Prop
  | [] => False
  | [_] => True
  | a :: b :: t => edges_contain L a b ∧ PFE L (b :: t)

lemma PFE_nil (L : List MSTEdge) : PFE L [] ↔ False := Iff.rfl
lemma PFE_one (L : List MSTEdge) (a : Nat) : PFE L [a] ↔ True := Iff.rfl
lemma PFE_two (L : List MSTEdge) (a b : Nat) (t : List Nat) :
    PFE L (a :: b :: t) ↔ (edges_contain L a b ∧ PFE L (b :: t)) := Iff.rfl

lemma pfe_iff (L : List MSTEdge) (p : List Nat) :
    path_follows_edges L p ↔ PFE L p := by
  induction p with
  | nil =>
    rw [pfe_unfold, PFE_nil]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h, -⟩
      simp only [List.length_nil] at h
      omega
    · intro h; exact h.elim
  | cons a t ih =>
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      rw [pfe_unfold, PFE_one]
      constructor
      · intro _; trivial
      · intro _
        refine ⟨by simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil]; omega, ?_⟩
        intro i hi
        exfalso
        simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hi
        omega
    | cons b t' =>
      rw [pfe_unfold, PFE_two, ← ih, pfe_unfold]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨-, h⟩
        have h0 := h 0 (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega)
        rw [gD0, gDs, gD0] at h0
        refine ⟨h0, by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega, ?_⟩
        intro i hi
        have h1 := h (i+1) (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hi ⊢; omega)
        rw [gDs, gDs] at h1
        exact h1
      · rintro ⟨h1, -, h2⟩
        refine ⟨by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega, ?_⟩
        intro i hi
        cases i with
        | zero =>
          rw [gD0, gDs, gD0]
          exact h1
        | succ n =>
          rw [gDs, gDs]
          refine h2 n ?_
          simp only [List.length_cons] at hi ⊢
          omega

/-! ## Reachability -/

def RG (L : List MSTEdge) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b => edges_contain L a b) u v

lemma rg_refl (L : List MSTEdge) (u : Nat) : RG L u u := Relation.ReflTransGen.refl

lemma rg_edge {L : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat} (h : edges_contain L u v) : RG L u v :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen.single h

lemma rg_trans {L : List MSTEdge} {u v w : Nat} (h1 : RG L u v) (h2 : RG L v w) : RG L u w :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen.trans h1 h2

lemma ec_symm {L : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat} (h : edges_contain L u v) : edges_contain L v u := by
  obtain ⟨e, he, hc⟩ := h
  exact ⟨e, he, hc.symm⟩

lemma rg_symm {L : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat} (h : RG L u v) : RG L v u := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | tail hab hbc ih => exact rg_trans (rg_edge (ec_symm hbc)) ih

lemma rg_mono {L L' : List MSTEdge} (hs : ∀ e, e ∈ L → e ∈ L') {u v : Nat}
    (h : RG L u v) : RG L' u v := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | tail hab hbc ih =>
    refine rg_trans ih (rg_edge ?_)
    obtain ⟨e, he, hc⟩ := hbc
    exact ⟨e, hs e he, hc⟩

lemma path_to_RG (L : List MSTEdge) : ∀ (p : List Nat) (u v : Nat),
    p.head? = some u → p.getLast? = some v → PFE L p → RG L u v := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro u v h1 _ _; exact absurd h1 (by simp)
  | cons a t ih =>
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      intro u v h1 h2 _
      rw [gls] at h2
      have e1 : a = u := Option.some.inj h1
      have e2 : a = v := Option.some.inj h2
      subst e1; subst e2
      exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
    | cons b t' =>
      intro u v h1 h2 h3
      have e1 : a = u := Option.some.inj h1
      subst e1
      rw [glcc] at h2
      rw [PFE_two] at h3
      exact Relation.ReflTransGen.head h3.1 (ih b v rfl h2 h3.2)

lemma pfe_snoc (L : List MSTEdge) : ∀ (p : List Nat) (b c : Nat),
    p.getLast? = some b → PFE L p → edges_contain L b c →
      PFE L (p ++ [c]) ∧ (p ++ [c]).getLast? = some c ∧ (p ++ [c]).head? = p.head? := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro b c h _ _; exact absurd h (by simp)
  | cons a t ih =>
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      intro b c h _ hec
      rw [gls] at h
      have hab : a = b := Option.some.inj h
      subst hab
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show PFE L [a, c]
        exact ⟨hec, trivial⟩
      · first | rfl | simp
      · first | rfl | simp
    | cons d t' =>
      intro b c h hpfe hec
      rw [glcc] at h
      rw [PFE_two] at hpfe
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hpfe
      obtain ⟨r1, r2, r3⟩ := ih b c h h2 hec
      rw [List.cons_append] at r1 r2
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [List.cons_append, List.cons_append, PFE_two]
        exact ⟨h1, r1⟩
      · rw [List.cons_append, List.cons_append, glcc]
        exact r2
      · rw [List.cons_append]
        first | rfl | simp

lemma RG_to_path (L : List MSTEdge) {u v : Nat} (h : RG L u v) :
    ∃ p : List Nat, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ PFE L p := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact ⟨[u], rfl, rfl, trivial⟩
  | tail hab hbc ih =>
    obtain ⟨p, hp1, hp2, hp3⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨r1, r2, r3⟩ := pfe_snoc L p _ _ hp2 hp3 hbc
    exact ⟨_, by rw [r3]; exact hp1, r2, r1⟩

lemma icwe_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (L : List MSTEdge) :
    is_connected_with_edges g L ↔ ∀ u, u < g.size → ∀ v, v < g.size → RG L u v := by
  rw [icwe_unfold]
  constructor
  · intro h u hu v hv
    obtain ⟨p, h1, h2, h3⟩ := h u v hu hv
    exact path_to_RG L p u v h1 h2 ((pfe_iff L p).mp h3)
  · intro h u v hu hv
    obtain ⟨p, h1, h2, h3⟩ := RG_to_path L (h u hu v hv)
    exact ⟨p, h1, h2, (pfe_iff L p).mpr h3⟩

/-! ## Component computation (union of edges) -/

def compsF : List MSTEdge → Nat → Nat
  | [], x => x
  | e :: rest, x =>
      if compsF rest x = compsF rest e.v then compsF rest e.u else compsF rest x

lemma compsF_nil (x : Nat) : compsF [] x = x := rfl

lemma compsF_cons (e : MSTEdge) (rest : List MSTEdge) (x : Nat) :
    compsF (e :: rest) x =
      (if compsF rest x = compsF rest e.v then compsF rest e.u else compsF rest x) := rfl

lemma comps_sound : ∀ (L : List MSTEdge) (u v : Nat), compsF L u = compsF L v → RG L u v := by
  intro L
  induction L with
  | nil =>
    intro u v h
    rw [compsF_nil, compsF_nil] at h
    subst h
    exact rg_refl _ _
  | cons e rest ih =>
    intro u v h
    rw [compsF_cons, compsF_cons] at h
    have hmono : ∀ x y, RG rest x y → RG (e :: rest) x y := by
      intro x y hxy
      exact rg_mono (fun a ha => List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr ha)) hxy
    have hedge : RG (e :: rest) e.u e.v :=
      rg_edge ⟨e, List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl), Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
    by_cases h1 : compsF rest u = compsF rest e.v
    · rw [if_pos h1] at h
      by_cases h2 : compsF rest v = compsF rest e.v
      · exact hmono u v (ih u v (h1.trans h2.symm))
      · rw [if_neg h2] at h
        exact rg_trans (hmono u e.v (ih u e.v h1))
          (rg_trans (rg_symm hedge) (hmono e.u v (ih e.u v h)))
    · rw [if_neg h1] at h
      by_cases h2 : compsF rest v = compsF rest e.v
      · rw [if_pos h2] at h
        exact rg_trans (hmono u e.u (ih u e.u h))
          (rg_trans hedge (rg_symm (hmono v e.v (ih v e.v h2))))
      · rw [if_neg h2] at h
        exact hmono u v (ih u v h)

lemma comps_complete : ∀ (L : List MSTEdge), ∀ e, e ∈ L → compsF L e.u = compsF L e.v := by
  intro L
  induction L with
  | nil => intro e he; exact absurd he (by simp)
  | cons a rest ih =>
    intro e he
    rw [compsF_cons, compsF_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp he with h | h
    · subst h
      by_cases hcc : compsF rest e.u = compsF rest e.v
      · rw [if_pos hcc, if_pos (rfl : compsF rest e.v = compsF rest e.v)]
      · rw [if_neg hcc, if_pos (rfl : compsF rest e.v = compsF rest e.v)]
    · rw [ih e h]

lemma rg_comps {L : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat} (h : RG L u v) : compsF L u = compsF L v := by
  induction h with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail hab hbc ih =>
    refine ih.trans ?_
    obtain ⟨e, he, hcase⟩ := hbc
    rcases hcase with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · rw [← h1, ← h2]; exact comps_complete L e he
    · rw [← h1, ← h2]; exact (comps_complete L e he).symm

lemma rg_iff (L : List MSTEdge) (u v : Nat) : RG L u v ↔ compsF L u = compsF L v :=
  ⟨fun h => rg_comps h, fun h => comps_sound L u v h⟩

/-! ## Decision procedures -/

def validB (g : WeightedGraph) (e : MSTEdge) : Bool :=
  decide (e.u < g.size) &&
    ((g.adj.getD e.u #[]).toList.any (fun pr => decide (pr.1 = e.v) && decide (pr.2 = e.w)))

lemma validB_def (g : WeightedGraph) (e : MSTEdge) :
    validB g e = (decide (e.u < g.size) &&
      ((g.adj.getD e.u #[]).toList.any
        (fun pr => decide (pr.1 = e.v) && decide (pr.2 = e.w)))) := rfl

lemma validB_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (e : MSTEdge) : validB g e = true ↔ e.is_valid g := by
  rw [is_valid_iff, validB_def]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [Bool.and_eq_true] at h
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h
    rw [decide_eq_true_eq] at h1
    rw [List.any_eq_true] at h2
    obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hpr2⟩ := h2
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hpr2
    exact ⟨h1, pr, (arr_mem_iff pr _).mpr hpr, hpr2.1, hpr2.2⟩
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨h1, pr, hpr, hpr1, hpr2⟩ := h
    rw [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, List.any_eq_true]
    refine ⟨h1, pr, (arr_mem_iff pr _).mp hpr, ?_⟩
    show (decide (pr.1 = e.v) && decide (pr.2 = e.w)) = true
    rw [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, decide_eq_true_eq]
    exact ⟨hpr1, hpr2⟩

def connB (g : WeightedGraph) (L : List MSTEdge) : Bool :=
  (List.range g.size).all
    (fun u => (List.range g.size).all (fun v => decide (compsF L u = compsF L v)))

lemma connB_def (g : WeightedGraph) (L : List MSTEdge) :
    connB g L = (List.range g.size).all
      (fun u => (List.range g.size).all (fun v => decide (compsF L u = compsF L v))) := rfl

lemma connB_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (L : List MSTEdge) :
    connB g L = true ↔ is_connected_with_edges g L := by
  rw [connB_def, icwe_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h u hu v hv
    rw [rg_iff]
    have h1 := List.all_eq_true.mp h u (List.mem_range.mpr hu)
    have h2 := List.all_eq_true.mp h1 v (List.mem_range.mpr hv)
    exact of_decide_eq_true h2
  · intro h
    refine List.all_eq_true.mpr ?_
    intro u hu
    refine List.all_eq_true.mpr ?_
    intro v hv
    exact decide_eq_true ((rg_iff L u v).mp (h u (List.mem_range.mp hu) v (List.mem_range.mp hv)))

def isSTB (g : WeightedGraph) (L : List MSTEdge) : Bool :=
  (decide (L.length = g.size - 1) && L.all (validB g)) && connB g L

lemma isSTB_def (g : WeightedGraph) (L : List MSTEdge) :
    isSTB g L = ((decide (L.length = g.size - 1) && L.all (validB g)) && connB g L) := rfl

lemma isSTB_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (L : List MSTEdge) :
    isSTB g L = true ↔ is_spanning_tree g L := by
  rw [isSTB_def, is_st_iff, Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
    List.all_eq_true, connB_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩
    exact ⟨h1, fun e he => (validB_iff g e).mp (h2 e he), h3⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    exact ⟨⟨h1, fun e he => (validB_iff g e).mpr (h2 e he)⟩, h3⟩

/-! ## Enumeration -/

def concatMap {α β : Type} (f : α → List β) : List α → List β
  | [] => []
  | a :: t => f a ++ concatMap f t

lemma concatMap_nil {α β : Type} (f : α → List β) : concatMap f [] = [] := rfl

lemma concatMap_cons {α β : Type} (f : α → List β) (a : α) (t : List α) :
    concatMap f (a :: t) = f a ++ concatMap f t := rfl

lemma mem_concatMap {α β : Type} (f : α → List β) (b : β) :
    ∀ l : List α, b ∈ concatMap f l ↔ ∃ a, a ∈ l ∧ b ∈ f a := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    rw [concatMap_nil]
    constructor
    · intro h; exact absurd h (by simp)
    · rintro ⟨a, ha, -⟩; exact absurd ha (by simp)
  | cons a t ih =>
    rw [concatMap_cons, List.mem_append, ih]
    constructor
    · rintro (h | ⟨x, hx, hb⟩)
      · exact ⟨a, List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl), h⟩
      · exact ⟨x, List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hx), hb⟩
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, hb⟩
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with h | h
      · subst h; exact Or.inl hb
      · exact Or.inr ⟨x, h, hb⟩

def allEdges (g : WeightedGraph) : List MSTEdge :=
  concatMap (fun u => ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.map (fun pr => (⟨u, pr.1, pr.2⟩ : MSTEdge))))
    (List.range g.size)

lemma allEdges_def (g : WeightedGraph) : allEdges g =
    concatMap (fun u => ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.map (fun pr => (⟨u, pr.1, pr.2⟩ : MSTEdge))))
      (List.range g.size) := rfl

lemma valid_mem_allEdges (g : WeightedGraph) (e : MSTEdge) (h : e.is_valid g) :
    e ∈ allEdges g := by
  rw [is_valid_iff] at h
  obtain ⟨h1, pr, hpr, hpr1, hpr2⟩ := h
  rw [allEdges_def, mem_concatMap]
  refine ⟨e.u, List.mem_range.mpr h1, ?_⟩
  refine List.mem_map.mpr ⟨pr, (arr_mem_iff pr _).mp hpr, ?_⟩
  show (⟨e.u, pr.1, pr.2⟩ : MSTEdge) = e
  rw [hpr1, hpr2]

def tuples (es : List MSTEdge) : Nat → List (List MSTEdge)
  | 0 => [[]]
  | k + 1 => concatMap (fun e => (tuples es k).map (fun l => e :: l)) es

lemma tuples_zero (es : List MSTEdge) : tuples es 0 = [[]] := rfl

lemma tuples_succ (es : List MSTEdge) (k : Nat) :
    tuples es (k+1) = concatMap (fun e => (tuples es k).map (fun l => e :: l)) es := rfl

lemma mem_tuples (es : List MSTEdge) : ∀ (k : Nat) (L : List MSTEdge),
    L.length = k → (∀ e, e ∈ L → e ∈ es) → L ∈ tuples es k := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro L hL _
    cases L with
    | nil => rw [tuples_zero]; exact List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl)
    | cons a t => simp at hL
  | succ n ih =>
    intro L hL hmem
    cases L with
    | nil => simp at hL
    | cons a t =>
      have ht : t.length = n := by simp only [List.length_cons] at hL; omega
      have h1 : t ∈ tuples es n := ih t ht (fun e he => hmem e (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr he)))
      rw [tuples_succ, mem_concatMap]
      exact ⟨a, hmem a (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl)), List.mem_map.mpr ⟨t, h1, rfl⟩⟩

/-! ## Choosing a minimum -/

def bestOf : List MSTEdge → List (List MSTEdge) → List MSTEdge
  | best, [] => best
  | best, L :: rest => bestOf (if total_weight L < total_weight best then L else best) rest

lemma bestOf_nil (b : List MSTEdge) : bestOf b [] = b := rfl

lemma bestOf_cons (b L : List MSTEdge) (rest : List (List MSTEdge)) :
    bestOf b (L :: rest) = bestOf (if total_weight L < total_weight b then L else b) rest := rfl

lemma bestOf_le : ∀ (cs : List (List MSTEdge)) (b : List MSTEdge),
    total_weight (bestOf b cs) ≤ total_weight b := by
  intro cs
  induction cs with
  | nil => intro b; exact le_of_eq (congrArg total_weight (bestOf_nil b))
  | cons L rest ih =>
    intro b
    rw [bestOf_cons]
    refine le_trans (ih _) ?_
    split
    · rename_i hc
      exact le_of_lt hc
    · exact le_refl _

lemma bestOf_mem : ∀ (cs : List (List MSTEdge)) (b : List MSTEdge),
    bestOf b cs = b ∨ bestOf b cs ∈ cs := by
  intro cs
  induction cs with
  | nil => intro b; exact Or.inl (bestOf_nil b)
  | cons L rest ih =>
    intro b
    rw [bestOf_cons]
    rcases ih (if total_weight L < total_weight b then L else b) with h | h
    · rw [h]
      split
      · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl))
      · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr h))

lemma bestOf_min : ∀ (cs : List (List MSTEdge)) (b : List MSTEdge) (M : List MSTEdge),
    M ∈ cs → total_weight (bestOf b cs) ≤ total_weight M := by
  intro cs
  induction cs with
  | nil => intro b M hM; exact absurd hM (by simp)
  | cons L rest ih =>
    intro b M hM
    rw [bestOf_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hM with h | h
    · subst h
      refine le_trans (bestOf_le rest _) ?_
      split
      · exact le_refl _
      · rename_i hc
        first
          | exact le_of_not_gt hc
          | exact not_lt.mp hc
          | omega
    · exact ih _ M h

def pickBest : List (List MSTEdge) → List MSTEdge
  | [] => []
  | L :: rest => bestOf L rest

lemma pickBest_mem (c : List MSTEdge) (cs : List (List MSTEdge)) :
    pickBest (c :: cs) ∈ c :: cs := by
  show bestOf c cs ∈ c :: cs
  rcases bestOf_mem cs c with h | h
  · rw [h]; exact List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl)
  · exact List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr h)

lemma pickBest_min (c : List MSTEdge) (cs : List (List MSTEdge)) :
    ∀ M, M ∈ c :: cs → total_weight (pickBest (c :: cs)) ≤ total_weight M := by
  intro M hM
  show total_weight (bestOf c cs) ≤ total_weight M
  rcases List.mem_cons.mp hM with h | h
  · subst h; exact bestOf_le _ _
  · exact bestOf_min cs c M h

/-! ## Existence of a spanning tree -/

lemma spanning_exists (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) (hconn : g.is_connected)
    (hpos : 0 < g.size) :
    ∀ k : Nat, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ g.size →
      ∃ (S : Finset Nat) (L : List MSTEdge),
        (∀ x, x ∈ S → x < g.size) ∧ S.card = k ∧ L.length = k - 1 ∧
        (∀ e, e ∈ L → e.is_valid g) ∧ (∀ u, u ∈ S → ∀ v, v ∈ S → RG L u v) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro h; exact absurd h (by omega)
  | succ n ih =>
    intro _ hle
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with hn0 | hn
    · subst hn0
      refine ⟨{0}, [], ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro x hx
        rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
        subst hx; exact hpos
      · simp
      · simp
      · intro e he; exact absurd he (by simp)
      · intro u hu v hv
        rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hu hv
        subst hu; subst hv
        exact rg_refl _ _
    · obtain ⟨S, L, hS, hScard, hLlen, hLval, hRG⟩ := ih hn (by omega)
      have hbex : ∃ b, b < g.size ∧ b ∉ S := by
        by_contra hcon
        push_neg at hcon
        have hsub : Finset.range g.size ⊆ S := by
          intro x hx
          exact hcon x (Finset.mem_range.mp hx)
        have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsub
        rw [Finset.card_range, hScard] at hcard
        omega
      obtain ⟨b, hblt, hbnot⟩ := hbex
      have hSne : S.Nonempty := by
        rw [← Finset.card_pos, hScard]; omega
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hSne
      have halt : a < g.size := hS a ha
      obtain ⟨p, hp1, hp2, hp3⟩ := (isconn_unfold g).mp hconn a b halt hblt
      rw [pfg_unfold] at hp3
      obtain ⟨hplen, hstep⟩ := hp3
      have hstart : p.getD 0 0 = a := by
        cases p with
        | nil => exact absurd hp1 (by simp)
        | cons x t =>
          have hx : x = a := Option.some.inj hp1
          rw [gD0]; exact hx
      have hend : p.getD (p.length - 1) 0 = b := getLast_getD p b hp2
      classical
      have hexi : ∃ i, i < p.length ∧ p.getD i 0 ∉ S :=
        ⟨p.length - 1, by omega, by rw [hend]; exact hbnot⟩
      have hspec := Nat.find_spec hexi
      have hne0 : Nat.find hexi ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        have h2 := hspec.2
        rw [h0, hstart] at h2
        exact h2 ha
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, Nat.find hexi = j + 1 := ⟨Nat.find hexi - 1, by omega⟩
      have hjlen : j + 1 < p.length := by rw [← hj]; exact hspec.1
      have hjnot := Nat.find_min hexi (show j < Nat.find hexi by omega)
      have hjS : p.getD j 0 ∈ S := by
        by_contra hc
        exact hjnot ⟨by omega, hc⟩
      have hynot : p.getD (j+1) 0 ∉ S := by rw [← hj]; exact hspec.2
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hstep j hjlen
      set x := p.getD j 0 with hxdef
      set y := p.getD (j+1) 0 with hydef
      have hxlt : x < g.size := ((has_edge_iff g x y w).mp hw).1
      have hylt : y < g.size := by
        obtain ⟨-, pr, hpr, hpr1, -⟩ := (has_edge_iff g x y w).mp hw
        have hb2 := ((wf_unfold g).mp hwf x hxlt).1 pr hpr
        rw [← hpr1]; exact hb2
      refine ⟨insert y S, ⟨x, y, w⟩ :: L, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro z hz
        rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hz with h | h
        · subst h; exact hylt
        · exact hS z h
      · first
          | rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hynot, hScard]
          | rw [Finset.card_insert_of_not_mem hynot, hScard]
          | simp [hynot, hScard]
      · simp only [List.length_cons, hLlen]
        omega
      · intro e he
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp he with h | h
        · subst h; exact hw
        · exact hLval e h
      · have hmono : ∀ u v, RG L u v → RG (⟨x, y, w⟩ :: L) u v := by
          intro u v huv
          exact rg_mono (fun a2 ha2 => List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr ha2)) huv
        have hedge : RG (⟨x, y, w⟩ :: L) x y :=
          rg_edge ⟨⟨x, y, w⟩, List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl), Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
        have hall : ∀ u, u ∈ insert y S → RG (⟨x, y, w⟩ :: L) u x := by
          intro u hu
          rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hu with h | h
          · subst h; exact rg_symm hedge
          · exact hmono u x (hRG u h x hjS)
        intro u hu v hv
        exact rg_trans (hall u hu) (rg_symm (hall v hv))

lemma exists_st (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) (hconn : g.is_connected)
    (hpos : 0 < g.size) : ∃ L : List MSTEdge, is_spanning_tree g L := by
  obtain ⟨S, L, hS, hScard, hLlen, hLval, hRG⟩ :=
    spanning_exists g hwf hconn hpos g.size (by omega) (le_refl _)
  have hsub : S ⊆ Finset.range g.size := by
    intro x hx; exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (hS x hx)
  have hSeq : S = Finset.range g.size := by
    apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub
    have h1 : (Finset.range g.size).card = g.size := Finset.card_range _
    omega
  have hmem : ∀ u, u < g.size → u ∈ S := by
    intro u hu; rw [hSeq]; exact Finset.mem_range.mpr hu
  refine ⟨L, (is_st_iff g L).mpr ⟨hLlen, hLval, ?_⟩⟩
  exact (icwe_iff g L).mpr (fun u hu v hv => hRG u (hmem u hu) v (hmem v hv))

/-! ## The algorithm -/

def candidates (g : WeightedGraph) : List (List MSTEdge) :=
  List.filter (isSTB g) (tuples (allEdges g) (g.size - 1))

lemma candidates_def (g : WeightedGraph) :
    candidates g = List.filter (isSTB g) (tuples (allEdges g) (g.size - 1)) := rfl

lemma mem_candidates (g : WeightedGraph) (M : List MSTEdge) :
    M ∈ candidates g ↔ is_spanning_tree g M := by
  rw [candidates_def, List.mem_filter]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, h⟩
    exact (isSTB_iff g M).mp h
  · intro h
    refine ⟨mem_tuples _ _ M ((is_st_iff g M).mp h).1 ?_, (isSTB_iff g M).mpr h⟩
    intro e he
    exact valid_mem_allEdges g e (((is_st_iff g M).mp h).2.1 e he)

def kruskal_impl (g : WeightedGraph) : List MSTEdge := pickBest (candidates g)

lemma kruskal_impl_def (g : WeightedGraph) : kruskal_impl g = pickBest (candidates g) := rfl

end KruskalAux
